Eczema.description: Eczema is a condition that causes the skin to become itchy, dry, cracked, sore and inflamed. Symptoms can vary from mild to severe and may occur in different areas of the body.
general_care: Avoid products that irritate the skin.
Eczema.medical_attention: Seek medical advice if symptoms are persistent, severe, worsening, infected, or interfering with daily activities.
Eczema.emergency_note: Severe skin symptoms, rapidly worsening redness, significant swelling, breathing difficulty, or other serious symptoms require urgent medical attention.

Psoriasis.description: Psoriasis is a skin condition that causes areas of skin to become dry, scaly and inflamed. It can affect different parts of the body and may occur in episodes of flare-ups and improvement.
general_care: Avoid scratching or picking affected areas.
Follow treatment prescribed by a healthcare professional.
Psoriasis.medical_attention: Seek medical advice if you think you have psoriasis, if symptoms become severe, or if treatment is not helping.
Psoriasis.emergency_note: Rapidly spreading redness, widespread pus-filled areas, severe illness, or other serious symptoms require urgent medical assessment.

Contact_dermatitis.description: Contact dermatitis is a type of eczema caused by contact with a particular irritant or allergen. It can cause the skin to become itchy, dry, cracked, blistered or inflamed.
common_areas: Areas exposed to an irritant or allergen
common_triggers: Other substances that irritate or trigger the skin
general_care: Identify and avoid known irritants or allergens.
Keep affected skin moisturised with a suitable emollient.
Rinse the skin after exposure to a known irritant when appropriate.
Avoid repeated exposure to substances that trigger symptoms.
Contact_dermatitis.medical_attention: See a doctor if symptoms are persistent, recurrent, severe, or do not improve after avoiding suspected triggers.
Contact_dermatitis.emergency_note: Severe swelling, difficulty breathing, widespread severe symptoms, or other signs of a serious allergic reaction require emergency medical attention.

Urticaria.description: Urticaria, also called hives, causes itchy raised areas or patches on the skin. It can occur suddenly and may disappear and reappear over time.
general_care: Keep the skin cool if heat makes symptoms worse.
Seek medical advice when symptoms are persistent or severe.
Urticaria.medical_attention: Seek medical advice if hives keep returning, are severe, or occur with other concerning symptoms.
Urticaria.emergency_note: Swelling of the lips, mouth, tongue or throat, difficulty breathing, difficulty swallowing, severe dizziness or fainting can indicate a serious allergic reaction and require emergency medical attention.
